timing_definitions.ttft: request start through first non-empty streamed content delta
timing_definitions.effective_prefill: API prompt tokens divided by TTFT; includes queueing, scheduling, prefill, and first-token work
timing_definitions.decode: API completion tokens after the first token divided by client-observed generation time
timing_definitions.tpot: client-observed generation time divided by API completion tokens after the first token
timing_definitions.mean_inter_token_latency: same per-request aggregate as TPOT in capacity-v3; not raw token-arrival timestamps
timing_definitions.aggregate_throughput: sum of API completion tokens divided by the wall-clock span of the concurrent run
